props.name: Pd nanocubes by reduction in water with Br-, deposited on alumina

batch_scale.definition: volume of colloid made in one run

props.method: aqueous reduction of Na2PdCl4 by ascorbic acid with PVP and KBr, then deposition on alumina
props.strategy: Br- chemisorbed on the growing particles caps the {100} facets, so the particles grow into cubes; PVP keeps the colloid dispersed

props.name: Heat PVP, ascorbic acid and KBr in water
props.method: in a 20 mL vial in an oil bath, magnetically stirred

props.name: Add the palladium salt and react
props.method: 3 mL of aqueous Na2PdCl4 added at once

props.name: Deposit the cubes on the alumina
props.method: the colloid in ethanol stirred with the support, then filtered

props.name: edge length of the Pd cubes (TEM)
props.definition: number mean of the edge lengths of the cubes counted

props.name: standard deviation of the edge lengths (TEM)
props.definition: standard deviation of the number distribution

props.name: particles counted (TEM)
props.definition: particles whose edge lengths make the distribution

props.name: the colloid as made: Pd cubes bounded by {100}
props.morphology: cubes with slightly truncated corners, a few rods

shape_fraction.definition: share of the particles counted that are cubes

props.name: Br- adsorbed on {100} lowers its surface energy below that o
props.statement: Br- adsorbed on {100} lowers its surface energy below that of {111}, so the particles grow as cubes; without KBr the same synthesis gives cuboctahedra

props.method: Fe(acac)3 encapsulated during ZIF-8 growth, pyrolysed, acid leached, pyrolysed again

props.statement: Fe is atomically dispersed as FeN4 sites; no Fe-Fe scattering and no Fe particles are seen

props.title: Socketed Ni particles exsolved from a titanate perovskite resist sintering (invented)

props.name: Perovskite by solid-state reaction, then Ni exsolved by reduction
props.method: ball-milled oxides and carbonate, calcined, then reduced in H2

props.name: Mill the oxides and carbonate in ethanol
props.method: planetary mill, zirconia jar and balls

props.name: mean Ni particle diameter (SEM)
props.definition: number mean of the diameters of the surface particles counted

props.name: LSTN after reduction, with exsolved Ni
props.morphology: Ni particles partly embedded (socketed) in the perovskite surface

props.name: The socketed Ni particles do not sinter in 100 h at 1073 K,
props.statement: The socketed Ni particles do not sinter in 100 h at 1073 K, unlike Ni impregnated on the same oxide
